title: APMU Software — bare-metal case-study software (EMSOFT 2026 artifact)
description: Bare-metal software for the case studies in the EMSOFT 2026 paper 'A Centralized Performance Monitoring Architecture for Heterogeneous Multicore SoCs,' run on the he-soc SoC on a Xilinx VCU118 board. The software we author is released under the MIT License; vendored third-party components retain their upstream licenses (SD-VBS / San Diego Vision Benchmark Suite (c) UC San Diego; PULP/AlSaqr board-support (c) ETH Zurich, Apache-2.0; RISC-V riscv-tests (c) UC Berkeley, BSD). Active development continues at https://github.com/Rodolfo-Pellizzoni-Lab/apmu-software
